feature: Adapter identity and the cross-adapter import rule
description: Every adapter file belongs to exactly one named adapter. Any import between two different adapters, in either adapter layer, is a boundary violation. Projects group split adapters through analyze.adapters, and hexa stays A+ by grouping its own split adapters and putting ports in front of its real couplings.

specs.description: A file listed by an analyze.adapters group belongs to that group's adapter.
specs.given: An AdapterMap built with groups [("cli", ["hexa-cli/src/commands", "hexa-cli/src/fmt.rs"])] and no layer keys.
specs.when: adapter_of is called for "hexa-cli/src/fmt.rs" and for "hexa-cli/src/commands/analyze.rs", each with layer AdaptersPrimary.
specs.then: Both calls return Some("cli").

specs.description: With no group, the longest analyze.layers key the file is under names its adapter.
specs.given: An AdapterMap with layer keys ["crates/x/src/adapters", "crates/x/src/adapters/store"] and no groups.
specs.when: adapter_of is called for "crates/x/src/adapters/store/disk.rs" and for "crates/x/src/adapters/store/mem.rs" (AdaptersSecondary), and for "crates/x/src/adapters/mail.rs" (AdaptersSecondary).
specs.then: The two store files get the same adapter. The mail file gets a different adapter from them, because the key covering it is the shorter "crates/x/src/adapters" key and not the store key.

specs.description: With no group and no layer key, the first path segment below adapters/secondary/ or adapters/primary/ names the adapter.
specs.given: An AdapterMap with no layer keys and no groups.
specs.when: adapter_of is called with AdaptersSecondary for "src/adapters/secondary/sqlite/repo.rs", "src/adapters/secondary/sqlite/schema.rs" and "src/adapters/secondary/http/client.rs", and with AdaptersPrimary for "src/adapters/primary/web/routes.rs".
specs.then: The two sqlite files return the same Some value. The http file and the web file each return a Some value different from the sqlite one and from each other.

specs.description: A file matched by no group, no layer key and no adapters/ folder segment is its own adapter.
specs.given: An AdapterMap with no layer keys and no groups.
specs.when: adapter_of is called with AdaptersSecondary for "tools/local_store.rs" and for "tools/telegram_notifier.rs".
specs.then: Each returns Some, and the two values differ.

specs.description: A layer key that names a source file also covers that file's module directory.
specs.given: An AdapterMap with layer keys ["src/store.rs"] and no groups.
specs.when: adapter_of is called with AdaptersSecondary for "src/store.rs" and for "src/store/disk.rs".
specs.then: Both return the same Some value.

specs.description: A file outside the adapter layers has no adapter, even when a group lists it.
specs.given: An AdapterMap with groups [("cli", ["hexa-cli/src"])].
specs.when: adapter_of is called for "hexa-cli/src/domain.rs" with Domain, and for the same file with Ports, Usecases, Infrastructure, CompositionRoot, EntryPoint and Unknown.
specs.then: Every call returns None.

specs.description: A key covers whole path segments only. A sibling whose name merely begins with the key's text is not under the key.
specs.given: An AdapterMap with layer keys ["src/store"] and no groups.
specs.when: adapter_of is called with AdaptersSecondary for "src/store/disk.rs" and for "src/storefront.rs".
specs.then: The two files do not get the same adapter.

specs.description: A group takes precedence over a layer key that also covers the file, so the file does not get the key's adapter.
specs.given: An AdapterMap with layer keys ["svc/adapters"] and groups [("mailer", ["svc/adapters/mail.rs"])].
specs.when: adapter_of is called with AdaptersSecondary for "svc/adapters/mail.rs" and for "svc/adapters/db.rs".
specs.then: mail.rs returns Some("mailer"). db.rs returns a value other than Some("mailer").

specs.description: Every file in an adapter layer has exactly one adapter, and the answer is deterministic. No file outside an adapter layer has an adapter.
specs.given: Any valid AdapterMap, any project-relative path and any HexLayer.
specs.when: adapter_of(path, layer) is called twice.
specs.then: Both calls return equal results. The result is Some exactly when layer is AdaptersPrimary or AdaptersSecondary, and None otherwise.

specs.description: An import between two different secondary adapters is reported as a violation.
specs.given: A project with no analyze.adapters, where "src/adapters/secondary/tools/run.rs" imports "src/adapters/secondary/local_store/mod.rs".
specs.when: hexa analyze is run on the project.
specs.then: The result contains one DependencyViolation for that edge, whose rule is "adapters must not import from other adapters". For that edge crosses_adapters returns true.

specs.description: An import from a primary adapter to a different secondary adapter is still reported.
specs.given: An ImportEdge from "src/adapters/primary/web/h.rs" (AdaptersPrimary) to "src/adapters/secondary/db/repo.rs" (AdaptersSecondary), and an empty AdapterMap.
specs.when: crosses_adapters is called on that edge.
specs.then: It returns true, and hexa analyze reports the edge with the rule "adapters must not import from other adapters".

specs.description: An import inside one adapter is not a violation.
specs.given: An edge from "src/adapters/secondary/sqlite/repo.rs" to "src/adapters/secondary/sqlite/schema.rs", both AdaptersSecondary, and an empty AdapterMap.
specs.when: crosses_adapters is called and hexa analyze is run.
specs.then: crosses_adapters returns false, and no violation is reported for the edge.

specs.description: A module declaring its own submodule stays exempt.
specs.given: A project where "src/adapters/mod.rs" declares the submodule "src/adapters/secondary", producing an edge between adapter-layer files.
specs.when: hexa analyze is run.
specs.then: No "adapters must not import from other adapters" violation is reported for that edge.

specs.description: An edge with an end outside the adapter layers does not cross adapters.
specs.given: An edge from "src/adapters/secondary/db/repo.rs" (AdaptersSecondary) to "src/ports/store.rs" (Ports), and an edge from "src/usecases/run.rs" (Usecases) to "src/ports/store.rs" (Ports).
specs.when: crosses_adapters is called on each edge.
specs.then: Both calls return false.

specs.description: An edge crosses adapters exactly when both ends are adapters with different adapter_of values, and the rule is the same in either direction.
specs.given: Any AdapterMap and any ImportEdge e.
specs.when: crosses_adapters(e) is evaluated, and also on e with from and to swapped.
specs.then: The result equals: both layers are adapter layers and adapter_of(from_file, from_layer) differs from adapter_of(to_file, to_layer). Swapping the ends does not change the result.

specs.description: A declared group turns imports between its members into imports inside one adapter.
specs.given: A .hexa/project.json with analyze.adapters {"cli": ["hexa-cli/src/commands", "hexa-cli/src/fmt.rs"]}, both paths classified AdaptersPrimary, and "hexa-cli/src/commands/analyze.rs" importing "hexa-cli/src/fmt.rs".
specs.when: hexa analyze is run.
specs.then: AdapterMap::new returns Ok, and no cross-adapter violation is reported for the edge.

specs.description: A path listed in two groups is rejected with an error naming it.
specs.given: Groups [("a", ["src/adapters/secondary/x.rs"]), ("b", ["src/adapters/secondary/x.rs"])].
specs.when: AdapterMap::new is called.
specs.then: It returns Err, and the message contains "src/adapters/secondary/x.rs".

specs.description: A group whose paths are in different layers is rejected with an error naming a path.
specs.given: A layer_of that maps "src/web" to AdaptersPrimary and "src/db" to AdaptersSecondary, and groups [("mixed", ["src/web", "src/db"])].
specs.when: AdapterMap::new is called.
specs.then: It returns Err, and the message contains "src/web" or "src/db".

specs.description: hexa analyze does not ignore an invalid adapters configuration.
specs.given: A project.json whose analyze.adapters lists one path in two groups.
specs.when: hexa analyze is run.
specs.then: The run reports a rule error naming the path. The rule error costs 10 points of the health score, as compute_health_score charges for rule errors.

specs.description: Any configuration that repeats a path across groups is rejected.
specs.given: Any groups list in which some path string appears in two different groups.
specs.when: AdapterMap::new is called with any layer keys.
specs.then: It returns Err, and the message contains a repeated path.

specs.description: hexa's own configuration groups its split adapters.
specs.given: hexa's .hexa/project.json.
specs.when: Its analyze.adapters is read and an AdapterMap is built from it.
specs.then: There are groups named cli, treesitter, inference-http and git. These pairs each resolve to the same adapter: hexa-cli/src/fmt.rs and hexa-cli/src/assets.rs with the commands files; treesitter_adapter.rs with treesitter_api.rs; vec_stream with the hexa-infer/src/adapters/secondary modules; and hexa-git's history.rs and worktree.rs with hexa-exec's git_history.rs and git_worktrees.rs.

specs.description: hexa's groups do not hide the real couplings.
specs.given: The AdapterMap built from hexa's .hexa/project.json.
specs.when: adapter_of is evaluated for the hexa-exec/src/tools files, local_store and telegram_notifier.
specs.then: No tools file shares an adapter with local_store or telegram_notifier, and local_store and telegram_notifier are different adapters.

specs.description: The hexa-exec tools reach the store and the notifier through ports that default_deps wires.
specs.given: hexa's source tree.
specs.when: The imports of every file under hexa-exec/src/tools are listed.
specs.then: None imports crate::local_store or crate::telegram_notifier. The store and the operator notifier the tools use are supplied by hexa_exec::default_deps().

specs.description: No direct adapter-to-adapter edge remains for the couplings named in the ADR.
specs.given: hexa analyzed with the within-layer rule on.
specs.when: The import graph is inspected.
specs.then: There is no edge from hexa-exec/src/tools to local_store or telegram_notifier, none from frontier.rs to hexa-infer's spend, and none from hexa-infer's discover, local_provider or spend to tiers or registry.

specs.description: hexa grades itself A+ with zero boundary violations under the corrected rule.
specs.given: hexa's repository, with the within-layer cross-adapter check on.
specs.when: hexa analyze . is run, and the hexa_grades_itself_by_ratchet test runs.
specs.then: An AdapterMap built from hexa's .hexa/project.json (analyze.layers keys and analyze.adapters groups) is Ok, and under it crosses_adapters is false for every import edge hexa analyze reads; zero boundary violations are reported, the grade is A+, and the ratchet test passes.

specs.description: No coupling is excused, and a new cross-adapter import breaks the ratchet.
specs.given: hexa's .hexa/project.json, and a copy of the tree with one added import from a hexa-exec tool to crate::local_store.
specs.when: The configuration is searched for exceptions, and hexa analyze plus the ratchet test are run on the modified copy.
specs.then: The configuration has no exception or allow-list entry for any adapter pair. The modified copy reports one "adapters must not import from other adapters" violation, its score drops by 10, and hexa_grades_itself_by_ratchet fails.
